# Port operators

Three kinds of buyer matter: container terminal operators, bulk terminal operators and utilities that run power lines near the quay. Container terminals have the most cranes per metre of quay and the strictest downtime rules, so they are the segment to test first. Utilities buy slowly and only after a trial.

Open questions: who pays for a field trial, and whether a terminal will share its crane layout.
